# Recipes and sections

A **section** is a reusable group of components. A **recipe** is a whole email built from sections and components. Both only produce data (nodes), so they can be remixed with another theme or variants. See [Recipes guide](recipes-guide.md) to write your own.

## Campaign recipes

Render one with `npm run remix -- recipe <id> --theme <theme>`, or in an email: `[[ recipe('<id>', { ... }) ]]`.

### Abandoned Cart

`abandoned-cart` &middot; suggested theme: `ecommerce`

Brings someone back to a cart they left: a gentle hero, the cart contents from Klaviyo event data, reassurance, an optional discount and a return-to-cart button.

- Content it takes: `hero`, `cart`, `benefits`, `socialProof`, `discount`, `cta`. Every recipe also takes `preheader`, `announcement`, `viewInBrowser`, `nav` and `footer`.
- Components used in the preview: `email/preheader`, `email/header`, `hero/text-only`, `commerce/cart-items`, `features/feature-grid`, `layout/section`, `social-proof/rating`, `saas/cta-section`, `email/footer`

## Sections

Use one in a recipe with `section('<id>', data)`, or in an email with `[[ recipeSection('<id>', { ... }) ]]`.

- `benefits`: A heading and a checklist of benefits, with an optional image and a button. Uses `features/benefits`.
- `best-sellers`: A heading and a grid of products with a view-all button. Uses `commerce/product-grid`.
- `cart-contents`: The products in a customer's cart or order, repeated from Klaviyo event data, with a total and a button. Uses `commerce/cart-items`.
- `cta`: A headline, a line of text and one or two buttons on a colored band. Uses `saas/cta-section`.
- `discount`: A discount banner with the value, an optional code and expiry, and a button. Uses `promotional/discount-banner`.
- `event-details`: The event details block, a row of speaker cards and an RSVP prompt. Uses `events/event-block`, `layout/grid`, `events/speaker-card`, `events/rsvp-block`.
- `feature-breakdown`: A heading, a grid of 2 to 4 features and an optional button. Uses `features/feature-grid`.
- `product-introduction`: Eyebrow, headline, description, product image and a button. Standard, split or text-only hero. Uses `hero/standard`.
- `social-proof`: A rating summary (stars, score, review count) and a customer testimonial. Uses `layout/section`, `content/heading`, `social-proof/rating`, `social-proof/testimonial`.
- `storytelling`: An image, a headline, a few paragraphs, an optional pull quote and a button. Uses `editorial/storytelling`, `layout/section`, `content/button`.
- `urgency`: Urgency headline, deadline, optional countdown and a button. Banner, countdown or last-chance style. Uses `promotional/urgency-banner`.
